segments.text:
V. 15.
Many publicans and notorious ſinners ſat with Jeſus— Some of them doubtleſs invited by Matthew, moved with Compaſſion for his old Companions in Sin. But the next Words, For they were many and they followed him, ſeem to imply, that the greater Part, encouraged by his gracious Words and the Tenderneſs of his Behaviour, and impatient to hear more, ſtayed for no Invitation, but preſt in after Him, and kept as cloſe to Him as they could.
